chart.$comment: A chart: a scene of scales and the marks drawn on them (0099). The colours are the series palette of the skin, by place, and the lines and words of the axes; the type is the small size, because an axis label sits beside the data rather than being read as prose. The line width and the gap between an axis and its labels are the chart's own. The cursor's line, its markers and its tooltip (phase 3) stand on the page's own surface rather than an inverted one, as `pct-tooltip`'s do: the tooltip names each series by its palette swatch, and the palette is measured against `surface` alone.

font-size.$description: Font size of the axis labels, the units and the empty message.

series-color-1.$description: Colour of series 1: its line, its area and its swatch.

series-color-2.$description: Colour of series 2: its line, its area and its swatch.

series-color-3.$description: Colour of series 3: its line, its area and its swatch.

series-color-4.$description: Colour of series 4: its line, its area and its swatch.

series-color-5.$description: Colour of series 5: its line, its area and its swatch.

series-color-6.$description: Colour of series 6: its line, its area and its swatch.

series-color-7.$description: Colour of series 7: its line, its area and its swatch.

series-color-8.$description: Colour of series 8: its line, its area and its swatch.

area-alpha.$description: How much of the series colour fills the area under a line.

edge-width.$description: Width of the top edge of an area, where two layers of a stack meet (0106).

body-bg-rise.$description: A candle that closes above its open (0106).

body-bg-fall.$description: A candle that closes under its open (0106).

grid-border.$description: Lines of the grid behind the data.

axis-border.$description: Line of an axis and its ticks.

axis-gap.$description: Gap between an axis and its labels.

unit-fg.$description: The unit written over a value axis.

message-fg.$description: The message of a chart with nothing to draw.

cursor-border.$description: The line of the cursor across the plot.

marker-border.$description: The ring around a marker on the cursor's line, which parts it from the line it stands on.

marker-size.$description: Diameter of a marker on the cursor's line: a drawing, no target, so it stays off the density axis.

tooltip-bg.$description: Background of the tooltip by the cursor.

tooltip-fg.$description: Text of the tooltip by the cursor.

tooltip-border.$description: Edge of the tooltip by the cursor.

zoom-gap.$description: Gap between the buttons of the zoom bar.

swatch-width.$description: Width of a series' swatch in a legend: its line with its dash, its marker on it.

swatch-height.$description: Height of a series' swatch in a legend.

legend-gap.$description: Gap between the entries of a legend.

legend-fg-muted.$description: The name of a hidden series in a legend.

toggle-target-min.$description: Touch-target floor of a legend entry's toggle.

remove-target-min.$description: Touch-target floor of a legend entry's remove button.

selection-bg.$description: Colour of the selected band across the plot, before the mix.

selection-alpha.$description: How much of the selection colour fills the band.

bar-radius.$description: Corner radius of a bar's far end.

bar-gap.$description: Gap between the bars of a group.

label-fg.$description: The value written over a bar.

label-font-weight-selected.$description: Font weight of the label over the selected bar.

bar-alpha.$description: How much of the series colour fills a compared period's bar.

reference-border.$description: A reference line across the plot, when its mark names no colour.

reference-fg.$description: The label written by a reference line or a band.

span-bg.$description: A band across the plot, before the mix, when its mark names no colour.

span-alpha.$description: How much of the band colour fills a band across the plot.

note-bg.$description: Background of a note's box on the plot.

note-fg.$description: Text of a note on the plot.

note-border.$description: Edge of a note's box, its leader and the dot on its point.

now-border.$description: The line of the present moment across the plot, and its label.

band-height.$description: A lane of states under the plot: the height of its band.

bubble-alpha.$description: How much of the series colour fills a bubble, so the ones under it show through.

heat-bg-1.$description: Step 1 of the sequential ramp of a heatmap, from the palest first to the deepest eighth; a cell mixes the two steps its value falls between.

heat-bg-2.$description: Step 2 of the sequential ramp of a heatmap, from the palest first to the deepest eighth; a cell mixes the two steps its value falls between.

heat-bg-3.$description: Step 3 of the sequential ramp of a heatmap, from the palest first to the deepest eighth; a cell mixes the two steps its value falls between.

heat-bg-4.$description: Step 4 of the sequential ramp of a heatmap, from the palest first to the deepest eighth; a cell mixes the two steps its value falls between.

heat-bg-5.$description: Step 5 of the sequential ramp of a heatmap, from the palest first to the deepest eighth; a cell mixes the two steps its value falls between.

heat-bg-6.$description: Step 6 of the sequential ramp of a heatmap, from the palest first to the deepest eighth; a cell mixes the two steps its value falls between.

heat-bg-7.$description: Step 7 of the sequential ramp of a heatmap, from the palest first to the deepest eighth; a cell mixes the two steps its value falls between.

heat-bg-8.$description: Step 8 of the sequential ramp of a heatmap, from the palest first to the deepest eighth; a cell mixes the two steps its value falls between.

heat-bg-low.$description: A heatmap cell at the low end of a diverging ramp.

heat-bg-mid.$description: A heatmap cell at the middle of a diverging ramp, where a value is neither.

heat-bg-high.$description: A heatmap cell at the high end of a diverging ramp.

heat-fg-1.$description: The value written on a cell of step 1: dark text on the pale steps, light on the deep ones.

heat-fg-2.$description: The value written on a cell of step 2: dark text on the pale steps, light on the deep ones.

heat-fg-3.$description: The value written on a cell of step 3: dark text on the pale steps, light on the deep ones.

heat-fg-4.$description: The value written on a cell of step 4: dark text on the pale steps, light on the deep ones.

heat-fg-5.$description: The value written on a cell of step 5: dark text on the pale steps, light on the deep ones.

heat-fg-6.$description: The value written on a cell of step 6: dark text on the pale steps, light on the deep ones.

heat-fg-7.$description: The value written on a cell of step 7: dark text on the pale steps, light on the deep ones.

heat-fg-8.$description: The value written on a cell of step 8: dark text on the pale steps, light on the deep ones.

heat-fg-low.$description: The value written on a cell at the low of a diverging ramp.

heat-fg-mid.$description: The value written on a cell at the mid of a diverging ramp.

heat-fg-high.$description: The value written on a cell at the high of a diverging ramp.

cell-gap.$description: The gap between the cells of a heatmap, so each reads as one.

ramp-height.$description: The bar of a colour ramp in the legend of a heatmap.

pie-gap.$description: The gap between the slices of a pie: a stroke of `pie-border` around each, so no angle is spent on it.

pie-border.$description: The colour of the gap between the slices of a pie: the surface it stands on.

pie-size-selected.$description: How far a selected slice of a pie stands out of the circle.

gauge-width.$description: The width of a gauge's track, and of the arc that fills it to the value.

gauge-font-size.$description: The value written in the middle of a gauge.

gauge-bg.$description: A gauge's track, under the value's arc.

gauge-fg.$description: A gauge's value: the needle at it, or the arc from the minimum to it while no band holds it.

gauge-bg-success.$description: A band of a gauge's range in the success tone, on the rim, and the value's arc while it falls in the band.

gauge-bg-warning.$description: A band of a gauge's range in the warning tone, on the rim, and the value's arc while it falls in the band.

gauge-bg-danger.$description: A band of a gauge's range in the danger tone, on the rim, and the value's arc while it falls in the band.

gauge-bg-info.$description: A band of a gauge's range in the info tone, on the rim, and the value's arc while it falls in the band.
